question: What are the payment terms in the Master Services Agreement (DEMO)? Include amounts, invoice deadlines and late-payment provisions.
evidence: Client shall pay a platform subscription fee of USD 18,500 per month for the Harrowgate platform (the "Monthly Subscription Fee"). … Provider shall invoice monthly in advance. Invoices are payable net thirty (30) days from the invoice date. … Undisputed amounts not paid when due accrue interest at one percent (1%) per month until paid.
note: USD 18,500 per month, invoiced monthly in advance, payable net 30 days from the invoice date, 1% a month on undisputed overdue amounts. A full answer may add the 15-day invoice-dispute window (4.5) and suspension 15 days after an overdue notice (4.9). The advice memo misquotes 4.2 as net sixty; an answer must give the MSA's own term and must not present 60 days as the MSA's term.
